_comment: Canonical field definitions shared across skills so prompts and code agree on meaning.

account.dataStack: Current warehouse + activation stack (e.g. 'Snowflake + Klaviyo + Meta'). Primary Northwind ICP signal.
account.signalNotes: Short freshest buying signal (funding, hiring, migration, pain).
account.accountResearch: Deep, web-sourced research narrative. LAZY: populated once if empty (researchedAt null) by the Account Research agent.
account.accountAiContext: Continually-updated current-state synthesis. Refreshed EVERY run by 03-build-context.
account.researchedAt: Timestamp Account Research last ran. null => research gate fires.

contact.lifecycleStage: Controlled vocab: Suspect | Marketing Engaged | MQL | Working | Pipeline | Closed Won | Nurture | Disqualified. Owned by marketing ops (CRM). INVARIANT: a contact on an opportunity (an OpportunityContact row) is always Pipeline. Being at an account that has an opp does not make the contact Pipeline.
contact.persona: Economic Buyer | Champion | Technical Buyer | Influencer. Drives angle + pillar.
contact.seniority: C-Level | VP | Senior Leadership | Director | Manager | Individual Contributor. Drives tone + length.
contact.recentRoleChange: Enrichment-only signal; the highest-value opener when present and not 'same role'.
contact.status: active | staged | merged. Hygiene promotes staged -> active (or merged).
contact.aiNextEmail: The rep-facing artifact the workflow writes (subject + body). Outreach builds the in-sequence email from it; a rep sends.

opportunity.stage: CRM opp stage string (e.g. '1 - Engage', '2 - Develop', '3 - Validate').
opportunity.nextStepHistory: Append-only OpportunityNextStep log (note, stage, setBy, createdAt). Drives opp_next_step trigger.
